levels.name: Crash Site
levels.hook: Dunes or the rock ridge? Then round the Ring. Your wheels decide.
levels.goal: Get the landing brakes from the far side of the crater.
newHere: Some ground drags on your wheels more than other ground. Sand drags six times more than rock.
To go round a bend, your tyres must push you sideways. Go faster than your grip allows and you slide wide.
Two roads at the fork: the short way through the dunes, or the longer, firm ridge. Which is faster depends on your rover.

levels.name: Push & Shove
levels.hook: Boost pads and cannons change your speed in an instant.
levels.goal: Run the cannon range to the next beacon.
newHere: A sudden push, called an impulse, changes your speed by the impulse divided by your mass.
When two things collide, their total momentum (mass times velocity) stays the same.
A heavier rover changes speed less in the same hit.

levels.name: Crater Field
levels.hook: Roll down, climb out. Height and speed trade places.
levels.goal: Cross the crater field to the next beacon.
newHere: Going down a slope trades height for speed. Going up trades speed for height.
A slope pulls you downhill, so a steep wall needs more push than a gentle ramp.
Every crater has a steep wall and a gentle ramp as the two ways out.

levels.name: Gravity Wells
levels.hook: Same rover, different gravity. What changes?
levels.goal: Cross the gravity fields to the next beacon.
newHere: In a gravity field your weight changes, but your mass does not.
Less weight means less grip and less friction. More weight means more of both.
A cannon hits just as hard in any field, because your mass did not change.

levels.name: The Crossing
levels.hook: Wade, float or sink. Cross the water.
levels.goal: Cross the flooded valley to the beacon.
newHere: Water pushes up on anything in it, with a force equal to the weight of the water pushed aside.
If the water pushes up harder than your weight, you float, and a floating rover cannot drive or steer. It only coasts.
Water also drags you back, more the faster you go.

levels.name: Polar Pass
levels.hook: Pull and push with a super electromagnet.
newHere: Like poles repel and unlike poles attract.
The pull gets weaker the further away you are.
An electromagnet works only while its current is on.

endless.name: Endless Canyon
endless.hook: How far can you go? Mud, gravity, boosts and cannons.

surface-mud.title: Mud
surface-mud.line: Friction here: {frictionN} N. On asphalt: {asphaltN} N.

surface-sand.title: Sand
surface-sand.line: Friction here: {frictionN} N. On asphalt: {asphaltN} N.

surface-ice.title: Ice
surface-ice.line: Friction here is only {frictionN} N, but the tyres can pass on at most {gripN} N.

slip.title: Wheels slip
slip.line: The tyres can pass on only {gripN} N here. Your motor asks for {askN} N.

gravity-low.title: Weaker gravity
gravity-low.line: g = {g} m/s². Your weight is {weightN} N. Your mass is still {massKg} kg.

gravity-high.title: Stronger gravity
gravity-high.line: g = {g} m/s². Your weight is {weightN} N. Your mass is still {massKg} kg.

slope-up.title: Uphill
slope-up.line: The slope pulls you back with {pullN} N ({massKg} × {g} × sin {angleDeg}°).

rollback.title: Rolling back
rollback.line: The slope pulls {pullN} N; your push and friction hold only {holdN} N.

bend.title: Corner: r = {radiusM} m
bend.line: Turning needs {massKg} × {speed}² ÷ {radiusM} = {needN} N. Your tyres give up to {gripN} N.

slide.title: Sliding wide
slide.line: This turn needs {needN} N. The tyres give only {gripN} N.

water-in.title: Water
water-in.line: Upthrust {upN} N. Your weight is {weightN} N.

float.title: You float
float.line: Upthrust {upN} N is more than your weight {weightN} N. No grip, no drive: you only coast.

magnet-attract.title: Magnet pulls
magnet-attract.line: Unlike poles attract: {forceN} N at {distM} m.

magnet-repel.title: Magnet pushes
magnet-repel.line: Like poles repel: {forceN} N at {distM} m.

magnet-off.title: Coils off
magnet-off.line: An electromagnet works only while its current is on.

pole.title: Your pole: {pole}
pole.line: Like poles repel. Unlike poles attract.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.line: Press R to come back here.

crash.title: Crash
crash.line: Back to the last checkpoint. The clock keeps running.

stuck.title: Stuck
stuck.line: Friction beats your motor. Back to the last checkpoint.

floated.title: Floated to a stop
floated.line: A floating rover cannot drive. Back to the last checkpoint.

fork-result-crash.title: The {otherRoad} road
fork-result-crash.line: At full throttle you would have {outcome}.

mud.title: Mud drags
mud.sentence: On mud the ground pulls back with {frictionN} N, against {asphaltN} N on asphalt.

sand.title: Sand drags
sand.sentence: On sand the ground pulls back with {frictionN} N, against {asphaltN} N on asphalt.

ice.title: Ice does not grip
ice.sentence: On ice the tyres can pass on only {gripN} N, so braking and turning are weak.

boost.title: The boost pad
boost.sentence: The pad gave an impulse of {impulseNs} N·s, so you sped up by {dv} m/s.

hit.title: The sandbag
hit.sentence: Your speed went from {before} to {after} m/s when the bag stuck to you.

gravity.title: Gravity changed
gravity.sentence: In this zone g was {g} m/s², so your weight was {weightN} N. Your mass stayed {massKg} kg.

descent.title: Height into speed
descent.sentence: Rolling down {dropM} m took you from {before} to {after} m/s.
maths: Potential energy lost = m × g × h

rollback.title: Rolled back
rollback.sentence: The slope pulled you back with {pullN} N, more than your push and friction could hold ({holdN} N).
maths: Slope pull = m × g × sin θ

slide.title: Slid wide in a bend
slide.sentence: The bend needed {needN} N sideways but the tyres could give only {gripN} N.
maths: Tyres give up to μ × k × R = {gripN} N

float.title: You floated
float.sentence: The water pushed up with {upN} N, more than your weight of {weightN} N, so the tyres lost their grip.

water.title: Water pushes up
water.sentence: The water pushed up with {upN} N, so the ground pushed up on you with less.

magnet.title: The magnet
magnet.sentence: The pylon pulled or pushed with {forceN} N at {distM} m.
maths: Like poles repel, unlike poles attract
The force is weaker further away

fork.title: Two roads
fork.sentence: You took the {yourRoad} road in {yourS} s. The {otherRoad} road would have taken {otherS} s.
maths: Same rover, same start, throttle held

fork-crash.title: Two roads
fork-crash.sentence: You took the {yourRoad} road in {yourS} s. At full throttle on the {otherRoad} road you would have {outcome}.
maths: Same rover, same start, throttle held

crash.title: Crashes
crash.sentence: You went back to a checkpoint {n} time(s) after a crash.

stuck.title: Stuck
stuck.sentence: You got stuck {n} time(s): the ground held you with more force than the motor could give.
maths: Stuck when the motor force is no more than friction plus the slope pull

slope.title: Slope
slope.line: A slope pulls a rover back with a force that grows with the steepness and with the weight. Your motor has to push harder than the pull to climb.

water.title: Water
water.line: Water pushes up on anything in it. When that upthrust is bigger than the weight, the rover floats, and its wheels can no longer grip.

magnet.title: Magnet
magnet.line: A magnet pulls or pushes without touching. Unlike poles attract and like poles repel.

stretch.legend: Against a clean drive (green: you were faster)
stretch.headlineEven: Every stretch was within {minGapS} s of a clean drive.

why.crash: You hit {obstacle}: back to the checkpoint.
why.hit: A sandbag hit took {lostMps} m/s off your speed.
why.grip: You were past your grip limit for {gripS} s: your wheels grip with up to {gripN} N.
why.scrape: You scraped the wall {n} time(s) and lost {lostMps} m/s against it.
why.rollback: You rolled backwards for {rollS} s: the slope pulled harder than your motor and friction could hold.
why.surface: You spent {surfaceS} s on {surface}, where the ground pulls back with {frictionN} N. On rock it pulls back with {rockN} N.
why.fork: You took the {yourRoad} road in {yourS} s. The {otherRoad} road would have taken {otherS} s.
why.none: No crash, slide or wall scrape was recorded here. You went in at {inMps} m/s and came out at {outMps} m/s.
why.gain: You went in at {inMps} m/s and came out at {outMps} m/s.
why.even: Your times were close to a clean drive all the way.

try.crash: Look for the gap between the boulders, and slow down before them.
try.hit: Watch for the launcher turning, and slow down or speed up to meet the bag.
try.grip: Try wheels with more grip, or a wider line.
try.scrape: Start the turn earlier and keep clear of the wall.
try.rollback: Try a stronger motor, or take more speed into the slope.
try.surface: Try smoother wheels, which drag less on soft ground, or take the firm road.
try.fork: At the fork, try the other road.
try.none: Try a different line, or change one part, and see what changes.
try.even: Try again and beat your time.

ship.openingLine: Your ship came down hard. Five parts lie scattered across this red planet. Find them all.

parts.name: Landing brakes
parts.pickupLine: On the Ring, grip gave you up to {grip} N of sideways force. These brakes use friction too: they stop the ship on the runway.

parts.name: Thruster
parts.pickupLine: Each vent gave you {impulse} N·s of push. A thruster throws gas back, and the ship gains equal momentum forward.

parts.name: Lift engine
parts.pickupLine: In the Heavy Cave your weight was {weight} N, but your mass stayed {mass} kg. To lift off, this engine must push harder than the ship's weight.

parts.name: Splashdown floats
parts.pickupLine: The river pushed up on you with {upthrust} N. On Earth, the capsule lands in the sea and floats for the same reason.

parts.name: Docking clamps
parts.pickupLine: You switched attract and repel to ride the pylons. These clamps are electromagnets: current on, they hold; current off, they let go.

tryThis.float: A heavier chassis sinks, so the tyres keep their grip on the riverbed.
tryThis.rollback: A stronger motor can climb a steeper slope from rest.
tryThis.mud: Smooth wheels have less rolling friction in mud.
tryThis.slide: Slow down before the bend: the safe speed is on the sign.
tryThis.default: Try again and beat your time.
